_comment: Works whose at-rest state is not the state that represents them. A preview photographs a work at one moment; for an interactive work that moment is its title card, which shows the invitation rather than the work. A hint tells the capture to enter the piece first. It never alters the work — only which moment of it the museum photographs, the same category of decision as an animation's settle time. Keyed by work id.

MNA-OR-0008-W-0017.note: Opens on a BEGIN title card over the glyph field. One click enters the run; the wait lets the field populate before the shutter.
